raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the source node goal is to move every reckon caller and citation of `crew ledger` and `crew velocity` behind `crew view` and tombstone both; these two commits complete it by making the retired ledger rollup reach one successor whichever way the caller spelled it — reckon/crew/tombstones.py:213 carries operand_aliases=(('summary','ledger'),) and reckon/crew/tombstones.py:333 adds successor_name(), so `crew ledger --view summary` renders as and reports `crew view ledger` rather than the fleet summary.
VERDICT done_when: the source done_when is the eleven-file gate adding zero failures against the base arm; the manifest's baseline_suite records the base arm at 33bb77708 as 2 failed / 257 passed and after_suite the head arm at 0e5a370 as 2 failed / 265 passed with the identical two failing ids, and logs/gate-head.log and logs/gate-base.log each open with their revision header and close with a bare EXIT= footer.
VERDICT write_paths: the source fence lists twenty paths and the manifest's changed_paths matches; the three files this increment changes — reckon/crew/tombstones.py, tests/test_read_verbs_retire_behind_crew_view.py and docs/evidence/fragments/the-crew-surface-is-one-tool-and-a-few-verbs/cso-ledger-and-velocity-retire.html — are all inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read at manifest.md; it records the gate command verbatim, both arm logs with revision headers and bare exit footers, a red negative control (1 failed, EXIT=1) plus three further controls with their logs, failure_attribution for the two carried reds, and blockers: none.
VERDICT diff: read the two commits gained since the last review against reviewed_base_sha 493cb5f6d — 0e5a37004 changes reckon/crew/tombstones.py and the test file, cf3b22b05 changes only the evidence fragment; git diff --stat over the pair names exactly those three files and no path outside the declared scope.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2719 (crew_ledger = tombstone_command('ledger')), reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2722 (crew_velocity = tombstone_command('velocity), reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:30 (_CrewGroup.get_command -> tombstone_command), reckon/crew/tombstones.py:362 (tombstone_command builds the hidden command), reckon/crew/tombstones.py:384 (_tombstone emits tombstone_payload)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/tombstones.py:213 maps the caller's --view summary onto the ledger operand and reckon/crew/tombstones.py:355 reports that view as the successor, so the retired rollup reaches one document however it is spelled.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: logs/gate-head.log closes '2 failed, 265 passed' at 0e5a370 with a bare EXIT=1 and logs/gate-base.log the same two ids at 33bb77708, so zero failures are added; the gated revision is 0e5a370 and the reviewed head cf3b22b is evidence-only.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff --stat 493cb5f6d cf3b22b names only reckon/crew/tombstones.py, tests/test_read_verbs_retire_behind_crew_view.py and the evidence fragment, each inside the declared fence, with nothing the goal does not imply.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_read_verbs_retire_behind_crew_view.py:311 asserts the printed invocation equals the successor the payload reports and :320 runs it requiring exit 0, and logs/control-summary-alias.log shows the summary case reddening (1 failed, EXIT=1) when the alias is repointed at the fleet summary.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: successor_name at reckon/crew/tombstones.py:333 mirrors the branch structure of successor_invocation at :306 and delegates to the same _operand_and_forwarded helper, and no added name or comment carries a plan label.
SCORE reuse: 18
JUSTIFICATION reuse: a capability search over reckon/crew for rendering a tombstone's successor found no earlier owner — the successor field was a static string — and the addition extends the module's own helper _operand_and_forwarded rather than duplicating it.
